requirements.title: Product changes begin as proposals
requirements.statement: Human/agent product changes are represented as proposals/deltas before accepted-state mutation.

requirements.title: Material product changes expose review rationale
requirements.statement: Acceptance/rejection records actor/authority, rationale and affected baseline/scope for material changes.

requirements.title: Baseline comparison is semantic
requirements.statement: Users/agents can compare accepted baselines by added/changed/retired entities/obligations/relations, not only raw storage diffs.

requirements.title: Rollback creates explicit historical state
requirements.statement: Rollback/reversion preserves the intervening accepted history and produces an explicit later baseline rather than rewriting history.

requirements.title: Milestones/releases project product state
requirements.statement: Milestone/release records reference exact product baseline/configuration and may aggregate readiness without becoming independent truth.

requirements.title: Deprecation and replacement are explicit
requirements.statement: Deprecated product entities/capabilities identify status, replacement/supersession and effectivity where applicable.

requirements.title: Journey revisions preserve historical meaning
requirements.statement: Changing journey steps/outcomes/requirements creates explicit revision/supersession semantics so prior evidence remains interpretable.

requirements.title: Journey failure and recovery are modeled
requirements.statement: Required journeys can declare failure/recovery branches and terminal non-success rather than only happy-path steps.

requirements.title: Journey applicability is configuration-bound
requirements.statement: Journey closure is assessed against the exact applicable product version/variant/configuration.

requirements.title: Product selection never silently changes scope
requirements.statement: Human navigation keeps the selected product/project/configuration explicit and cannot silently fall back to another product's data.

requirements.title: Complete inventory has explicit completeness semantics
requirements.statement: Human inventory views expose whether the selected product/entity set is complete, filtered, paginated or partial.

requirements.title: Entity detail explains canonical context
requirements.statement: Detail views expose canonical identity/type/baseline/applicability and relevant relations/evidence/findings sufficient to orient the user.

requirements.title: Relationship editing respects typed semantics and authority
requirements.statement: Human relationship creation/change validates relation type/endpoints/authority and preserves history where accepted truth changes.

requirements.title: Search results preserve scope and canonical identity
requirements.statement: Search identifies product/baseline/entity context and cannot merge same-named entities across products/configurations.

requirements.title: Derived knowledge has freshness/applicability
requirements.statement: Memory/recommendation/derived knowledge can become stale or invalid for a later baseline/configuration and this is explicit.

requirements.title: Derived knowledge conflicts are represented
requirements.statement: Conflicting derived claims preserve sources/confidence and cannot silently select the more convenient claim as truth.

requirements.title: Derived intelligence is reproducibly attributable
requirements.statement: Where practical, derived findings retain method/model/version/inputs sufficient to explain or re-run the derivation.

requirements.title: Recovery quality is independently graded
requirements.statement: A recovered product reports whether intent, requirements, journeys, implementation mapping, evidence and historical rationale are recoverable, separate from runtime feature completion.

requirements.title: Fresh-agent recovery is an oracle
requirements.statement: A fresh authorized agent can locate canonical thesis, contract, decisions, journeys, current state and blockers without owner replay or treating stale docs as authority.

requirements.title: External validation remains separate
requirements.statement: User/adoption/external validation evidence is represented separately from internal implementation/evidence completion and is never fabricated when absent.
